results.text:
# The default playbook for enterprise AI is to wrap a chat interface around a frontier model and sell access. For most of the real economy, that's the wrong tool. · 2026-05-11T00:00:00+00:00

The default playbook for enterprise AI is to wrap a chat interface around a frontier model and sell access. For most of the real economy, that's the wrong tool.

What businesses actually need is software, production systems that take over the workflows their teams run today. CRM, project management, AR/AP, scheduling, commissions, dispatch, intake. The unsexy stuff that holds these companies together.

We've spent the last year building exactly that at Ciridae. At one of our customers, 100s of millions in topline, we replaced four core systems in three months. An agent now runs their monthly close in a single click, work that used to take their finance team two weeks. Their entire business runs atop our software. This is real AI Transformation. This is what every business in the world will look like when operating atop Ciridae systems.

Today we're announcing our $20M seed, led by Accel with a16z and General Catalyst joining. Thanks to our customers, our team, and everyone who bet on us early.

# Two weeks ago, we announced Brief. Today, we are announcing that Brief has closed a $5M seed round, led by EPIC Ventures with participation from Boulder Ventures. · 2026-05-12T00:00:00+00:00

Two weeks ago, we announced Brief. Today, we are announcing that Brief has closed a $5M seed round, led by EPIC Ventures with participation from Boulder Ventures.

Within hours of our launch announcement, the same observation was coming back from many directions. "Systems of record capture data, but they don't maintain understanding." Developers have Claude Code and Cursor for the engineering work that defines their day. Executives have had nothing for the judgment-heavy work that defines theirs. That is the gap we built Brief to close.

EPIC and Boulder recognized the problem too, and quickly committed to helping us build Brief. The seed round gives us the funding to make the solution a reality.

# $2 Trillion a Year Never Makes It from Obligation to Settlement. Rivvun AI Is Built to Recover It

 June 10, 2026 

## Icertis veterans raise $7.55 million seed for Rivvun AI to recover enterprise spend and revenue leakage — Co led by Sitara Capital and 3one4 Capital

SEATTLE, Wash. — Rivvun AI Inc. today announced a $7.55 million oversubscribed seed round led by Sitara Capital and 3one4 Capital, to deploy an autonomous AI execution layer purpose-built for enterprise spend and revenue recovery.

The scale of the problem is staggering. McKinsey research finds that enterprise procurement functions lose up to one-third of planned savings during execution — with an additional 3– 4% of total external spend lost to transaction inefficiency and noncompliance. Across fortune 2000 revenues that compounds to more than $2T in value that never reaches the bottom line. The money isn’t lost to fraud or bad contracts. It disappears in the gap between what was contractually committed and what enterprise systems were ever built to collect.

Built by the Executives Who Saw
